newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to take delivery of U.S. landing frigates.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to take delivery of U.S. landing frigates.

text.p: Taiwan said on Friday it was scheduled to take delivery of two landing frigates leased from the United States later in the day or early on Saturday.
The New Port-class frigates, called LSTs, were designed to transport tanks, a spokesman for the navy said by telephone.
"The frigates are on their way to (southern) Kaohsiung. They should arrive later today or early tomorrow," the spokesman said.
He declined to reveal the price for leasing the vessels.
Taiwan has ordered six Lafayette-class missile frigates from France and has taken delivery of two so far.
It also is paying T$15 million (US$590,000) each for 160 second-hand U.S.-made M60A3 tanks, all of which are more than 10 years old.
Taiwan maintains it needs such weapons to counter the rapid military modernisation of China, the island's arch rival since the Chinese civil war separated them in 1949.

China held war games and unarmed missile tests in the Taiwan Strait in the weeks before Taiwan's March 23 presidential election in what Beijing acknowledged was a bid to intimidate voters against pursuing independence.
Beijing vows to retake Taiwan by force if the island opts for independence. (US$1 = T$27.5)
